newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTO'S LULA SUFFERS SUSPECTED BROKEN LEG.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTO'S LULA SUFFERS SUSPECTED BROKEN LEG.

text.p: Porto's Brazilian defender Luis `Lula' Marcos was taken to hospital with a suspected broken leg on Sunday.
He was carried off 15 minutes from the end of the uninspiring 0-0 home draw with lowly Estrela da Amadora.
Champions Porto were jeered off at the end. They had shown none of the flair that has taken them to the head of their European Cup Champions' League group.
The visitors even had the best chance of the game. Only a fine save by Polish goalkeeper Abdrezej Wosniak prevented Amadora's Jose Carlos from scoring with just four minutes remaining.
The stalemate allowed rivals Sporting into a two-point lead at the top of the Portuguese league. Sporting beat Leca 1-0 away on Saturday.
